Method of Attack: Installed by attackers to map the cloud environment and execute system commands without deploying malicious code on the server

Attack Vector: Exposed Docker API allowing creation of a clean Ubuntu container to mount on victim server
Local user 'hilde' with elevated privileges used to connect via SSH
Access to Weave Scope dashboard via HTTP on port 4040
Indicators of Compromise: Accessible Weave Scope dashboard on port 4040 from outside the network
